q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance cold_snap cold) exposes the modifier as the compound's genus while omitting the head-noun genus (snap), which the compound-kind rule says is always emitted; the modifier genus is only ever an addition to the head genus, never a substitute for it.

(Ongoing sk_distribute_1) puts a status atom on a non-finite control complement, which the control-verb pattern says carries no tense/status of its own, and "continued to V" is not one of the four enumerated Ongoing markers (progressive morphology, continuative perfect, inceptive complement, perception participle).

"No lantern on the Cliff Path" is ranged over (PartOf $x sk_lanterns_1) — the keepers' lantern group from sentence 1 — instead of the restricted kind (Member $x lantern) plus the restriction as a premise conjunct, narrowing the blanket denial to one previously-introduced set.

(On sk_lanterns_1 cliff_path) asserts that the keepers' lantern group is on the Cliff Path; the text attaches "on the Cliff Path" to the keepers and to the quantified "no lantern", never to those lanterns as a group.

q2_gaps: A continuative aspectual verb ("continued to V") is not covered: the instruction set gives Inception (began/started to V) and cessation (no longer / used to) but no form for continuation of an ongoing activity.

"ended after three nights" — a relative-offset temporal adjunct with an unnamed anchor has no licensed form; the parse re-reads it as the eventuality's own duration Measure, which states a total extent the sentence gives only relative to an implicit start.
notes: go_out kept whole with no genus, the cold/wind split into two Member atoms, the capitalized-common-noun Council with no Name atom, the RestOf partitive and throughout->During are all exactly per doctrine. The per-member add rule beside the group event and the paired strength-0 denial plus rule for "no lantern" follow the plural-distribution and negated-group patterns.
